title: Set up a stage’s alerts
summary: Choose who is alerted and how when an order enters the stage, stays too long or misses its due date.

steps.title: Menu → Business Setup → Lab Stages
steps.details: The stages every lab order goes through, in order.

steps.title: Click the stage’s bell
steps.details: Each stage has its own, on its row.

steps.title: When an order arrives
steps.details: The sentence says who is alerted and how. Example: on “Received at clinic”, the doctor, so they book the fitting. Tap “Order’s doctor” or “Order creator” to add or remove them.

steps.title: If it spends more days than expected
steps.details: When the order goes past the stage’s overdue days. In “Customize” you can repeat it every X days.

steps.title: If the due date passes
steps.details: The day after the due date, if the order is still in this stage.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: “Customize” adds roles, users, email or WhatsApp with a template. If the page had other changes, the button says “Apply” and you then press Save at the top.
